pathfinding.title: Pathfinding
pathfinding.paragraph: When active, Anyfinder Next will attempt to find the shortest path when dragging a Token.

togglePathfinding.name: Toggle Anyfinder Next Pathfinding
togglePathfinding.hint: Toggles your personal pathfinding preference without opening token controls.

forcePathfindingAllPlayers.name: Enable Pathfinding for Everyone
forcePathfindingAllPlayers.hint: When on, pathfinding is enabled for all players by default. When off, players can choose it from the scene controls.

fogExploration.name: Respect Explored Fog
fogExploration.hint: When on, tokens cannot route through areas the current player has not explored.

enableGridlessPathfinding.name: Enable Pathfinding on Gridless Maps
enableGridlessPathfinding.hint: When on, you and each player may encounter a short slowdown on first movement.
enableGridlessPathfinding.confirmation:
When using Gridless Pathfinding, you and each player may encounter a short slowdown on the first movement. This happens once per scene or session, while calculating or loading a cached pathfinding map.

Gridless Pathfinding is not perfect. You may encounter areas that take longer to compute, and areas that only allow precise path drawing with mouse movement. If you encounter problems, wait and move the mouse a bit to find a better point to drop your token.

gridlessNodeStepPx.name: Gridless Route Detail
gridlessNodeStepPx.hint: Lower values follow walls and narrow passages more closely but take longer. Higher values are faster but may skip narrow passages.

gridlessMinCenterClearancePx.name: Wall Clearance (Pixels)
gridlessMinCenterClearancePx.hint: Extra space kept between a token and walls. Increase this if tokens brush against walls.

gridlessAllowSqueeze.name: Allow Tight-Passage Movement
gridlessAllowSqueeze.hint: Allows a configurable amount of the token to overlap wall clearance in narrow passages. The token center remains clear of walls so vision cannot cross through them.

gridlessWallOverlapPercent.name: Tight-Passage Wall Overlap (% of Token Width)
gridlessWallOverlapPercent.hint: Maximum token-width overlap allowed in a narrow passage. Lower values keep more clearance; higher values help tokens fit through tighter spaces.

gridlessSqueezeLeewayPx.name: Tight-Passage Allowance (Pixels)
gridlessSqueezeLeewayPx.hint: How much narrower a passage may be when tight-passage movement is enabled.

gridlessExactFitTolerancePx.name: Exact-Fit Tolerance
gridlessExactFitTolerancePx.hint: Advanced collision tolerance for passages that exactly match a token's size.

debugMode.name: Enable Diagnostic Logging
debugMode.hint: Records pathfinding details for troubleshooting. Leave this off during normal play.

debugLogMode.name: Diagnostic Detail
debugLogMode.hint: Choose how much technical information appears in the console and saved traces.

gridlessDebugMaxTraces.name: Diagnostic Trace Limit
gridlessDebugMaxTraces.hint: Maximum number of diagnostic traces kept in memory.
